items.criterion: Two simultaneous approvals of one open stage leave exactly one recorded decision.
items.judgment: Fire two approvals at one barrier against the same open stage and count the decision rows that survive.

items.criterion: A grant ends on the earliest of the campaign end, the licence duration, a shortened override and the requester's engagement end.
items.judgment: Approve a request whose campaign runs past the engagement end, then compare the grant end date against the engagement end date.

items.criterion: A retried approval of an already approved request yields the grant that exists rather than a second one.
items.judgment: Approve the last open stage twice and count the grant rows carrying that request identifier.

items.criterion: A download of a restricted asset without a covering grant is refused, leaving no download record.
items.judgment: Ask for the mark as a partner whose engagement excludes it, then read the status and count the download rows.

items.criterion: Availability is decided for the calling principal, so two principals see different badges on the same asset.
items.judgment: Read the library as an employee and as a bounded partner, then compare the badge on one restricted asset.

items.criterion: An application class of co-brand adds a legal stage to the request.
items.judgment: Submit a co-brand request and count the stages the response names.

items.criterion: A request against the mark carries a second stage held by a reviewer distinct from the first.
items.judgment: Submit a request against a mark asset and compare the two stage holders.

items.criterion: An audit record survives every attempt to alter or remove it.
items.judgment: Query the record, attempt a removal, then query again and compare the rows.

items.criterion: Exactly one audit record is written for each request transition.
items.judgment: Drive a request from submission to grant, then count the records against the transitions that happened.

items.criterion: An employee session is refused the approval queue and the stage decision endpoint, leaving the stage unchanged.
items.judgment: Call both endpoints with an employee token, then read the stage back as a reviewer.

items.criterion: A partner is refused an asset class outside their engagement and refused everything once the engagement end date has passed.
items.judgment: Download inside the engagement, outside it, and again as the partner whose engagement has lapsed.

items.criterion: A reviewer is never assigned a stage of a request they raised themselves.
items.judgment: Raise a request as a reviewer, then read the stage holders and call the decision endpoint as the requester.

items.criterion: A withdrawal recorded while a reviewer is deciding wins over the decision.
items.judgment: Withdraw a request, then decide its open stage and read the resulting state.

items.criterion: Retiring an asset with an open request against it rejects that request and names the successor.
items.judgment: Retire the asset under review, then read the request state and the reason.

items.criterion: An anonymous caller holding a protected object address is refused the binary.
items.judgment: Read the object address from a restricted asset, then ask for it with no credential.

items.criterion: A reserved address answers the product's own not found page rather than a framework default.
items.judgment: Ask for each reserved address and look for the product's own chapter menu in the answer.

items.criterion: A submitted request stores the chapter version and the policy version that applied when it was asked.
items.judgment: Submit a request, then read back the stored version fields.

items.criterion: A grant waiting on an unaccepted proof releases nothing until the proof is accepted.
items.judgment: Approve with a proof condition, attempt a download, accept the proof, then attempt the download again.

items.criterion: The eight chapters render in the display order stored on the chapter record.
items.judgment: Read the chapter collection and compare the served order against the stored display order.

items.criterion: Every response carries the strict transport, nosniff, frame ancestry and referrer headers.
items.judgment: Read the headers on a public route, an API collection and a refusal.

items.criterion: A recorded cookie answer survives a reload without the question returning.
items.judgment: Answer the consent question, reload the hub, then look for the question again.

items.criterion: A form submission that fills the decoy field is refused, leaving nothing written.
items.judgment: Submit with the decoy field populated, then count the rows the form would have created.

items.criterion: Every seeded principal, chapter and asset exists exactly once after a restart.
items.judgment: Count the seeded rows, restart the app, then count them again.

items.criterion: A failed sign in answers the same shape whether or not the address exists.
items.judgment: Sign in with an unknown address and with a known address plus a wrong password, then compare the two answers.
